summary: Frontend-only parity test for iter 193 UI changes (Wayly): (1) Web + Mobile dashboard 'Things to know' collapsible default-collapsed, (2) Mobile AI Tools info-chip hide/show by paid vs trialing state, (3) Mobile shared PageIntro default-collapsed, (4) Mobile Plan & Billing Family copy '2 Participants included and 3 Caregiver seats', (5) Capitalisation of 'Participant'/'Caregiver' on web visible copy. Overall the changes work as designed. One residual lowercase 'participants' string found on the web Landing page ('Providers' block) and one on the Landing FAQ ('adult-child caregiver').
